notes.title: Skills QOL
notes.content:
Based on seeing some players stream the game, some small updates w.r.t. the skill trees were made:

* change tooltips to show which level skills unlock
* show icon when skills are locked or inaccessible (due to dependent skill not chosen, or player took another skill path)
* some effects when skills unlock
* added a header while making a new game, 'customize squad' to be clearer what the panel is for. 

Currently work is done on expanding the amount of hero classes to choose from.

Happy matching!

notes.title: I choose you!
notes.content:
This update's main features are difficulty settings and a flexible squad composition. Now you can choose who to send into the fray! 

[list]
[*] Added a step before starting new game to customize your squad a bit; this means you can now choose your avatar, color, hero class and change the hero name.
[*] Added a difficulty setting; you now have three choices: easy, normal, hard (rough). Easy will have 1 color less on the board, whereas hard will give you additional zombies to deal with.
[*] Tweaked BGM logic a bit, sometimes it wouldn't select the next audio clip
[*] Added Chinese (simplified) translations
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9.1c
notes.content:
That was some interesting work, to make the entire game compatible with multiple languages!
If your language is not represented in the game, but you'd like to - give us a shout on our discord, all translation help is welcome :)

* Made all text components compatible for multiple languages
* Already had English, but now added Brazilian-Portuguese, Thai and Dutch
* Simplified Chinese WIP
* added a credits screen, accessible through main menu. Now the proper parties can recieve kudos :)
* QOL: changed colors of buttons w.r.t. selection and default around, making the colors more intuitive when used for tabs (think high scores etc).
* FIX: in post-battle, the popup menu's 'save & back to menu' didn't work properly.

notes.title: Got friends?
notes.content:
Version 0.9.0 brings some balance changes, QOL fixes and features:

[list]
[*] improved zombie targeting to stay focused on the heroes
[*] added steam leaderboards, you can now see your friends' highscores! 
[*] added 'friends scores' section in highscores
[*] fixed a shader issue on linux causing some text to sometimes disappear
[*] fixed an issue where you could still save a game after you lost all squad members, kinda weird loading that one :D
[*] large matches now give bigger score multipliers
[*] fix active skill shots not used being carried to next round
[*] improve the shots some heroes gain from matches
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.8
notes.content:
- enhance colors for the zombies, making them stand out more with their pretty clothes
- fix for horizontal match of 4 not always clearing the swapped tile
- make tiles drop nicely from above, no more 'folding out'
- fix for linux slow block dropping
- fix menu behavior in post-battle (there was no escape. Now there  is. Or is there?)
